adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh flow checks `if (response.statusText !== "OK")` to decide failure. `statusText` is not a reliable success indicator (can be empty in some environments and varies by implementation/proxies), so this can incorrectly reject valid 200 responses. Using `response.ok` or checking `response.status` would avoid false negatives.
